categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of land title determinations for specific parcels of land, including detailed schedules with parcel numbers, extents, owner names, and land classifications. The content is published in "PART III - LANDS" and focuses entirely on land ownership and title settlement, making it clearly a Land Gazette (Type 4) according to the classification criteria.
